---
title: "Our Code Style Guide"
---

A short statement of why consistent style matters to your group.

## Naming

Use lowercase names with underscores.

```r
# Good
clean_data <- read_csv("data/raw_data.csv")

# Bad
CleanData <- read_csv("data/raw_data.csv")
```

## Spacing

Put spaces around operators and after commas.

```r
average <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
```

## Comments

Explain *why*, not *what*.

::: {.callout-tip}
Code blocks get a copy button automatically (set by `code-copy: true` in `_quarto.yml`).
:::
